ctx.x: Terry, Droogan, Frank Lake, Schema, Drusie, uh, Nails Martin. It was a place where the boys hung out and it was, uh, it was run pretty nice. There was never any trouble. And they had, uh, men entertainers and girl entertainers would go out and spread after the set and sing to each table. They'd sing, uh, Ace in the Hole and, uh, what's this other thing? It was a Tart song. Oh, it made a million dollars. Frankie and Johnny and all those songs. It's the good old days. What were your hours?
How long did you play there?
